symptom: SEO money-page changes were already present on main while Netlify production lagged behind.
In the delivery version active during the incident, Required selected an older cancelled BRAIN run for the same exact head.
A green workflow_dispatch BRAIN run did not satisfy that historical gate because it filtered event=pull_request.
During later closure the control plane evolved: Required became the canonical single-flight PR aggregate gate and stopped polling sibling workflows.
root_cause: Production drift can exist independently of code correctness and must be reconciled against current main rather than rebuilt.
Recovery logic was initially applied from historical gate semantics without first re-reading the newer producer/consumer workflow contract.
Delivery topology can evolve while an obligation remains open; replaying an obsolete trigger pattern can recreate duplicate CI and queue pressure.
prevention: For SEO/content changes already contained in current main, reconcile production drift on the same obligation instead of creating duplicate product changes.
Before rerunning or restoring delivery workflows, inspect the current Required and Unified Brain workflow definitions together.
Preserve historical event=pull_request sibling evidence as audit context only; do not assume the current gate still polls siblings.
Under the current single-flight architecture, Required is the canonical PR aggregate gate and Unified Brain Delivery remains explicit recovery/dispatch authority.
Do not reintroduce native PR-triggered BRAIN fan-out solely to reproduce an obsolete recovery path.
After protected merge, compare current main SHA with Netlify production commit_ref and deploy exact current main when they differ.
Keep provider exact-SHA proof separate from functional browser proof and scope functional acceptance to the obligation under recovery.
failed_approaches: Blindly rerunning Required while a historical consumer still selected the older cancelled sibling run.
Treating a green workflow_dispatch BRAIN run as equivalent to an event=pull_request sibling under the historical gate.
Attempting to restore the old BRAIN pull_request trigger after the control plane had already moved to a single-flight Required architecture.

current_authority.required_contract: canonical single-flight aggregate gate; selected lanes evaluated directly without polling sibling workflows
current_authority.queue_rule: do not recreate duplicate PR fan-out
